title: Fruits of the Spirit Epistemic and Institutional Rating Rubric

score_scale.1: deficient: mostly absent, performative, or contradicted by consequential behavior
score_scale.2: mixed_or_unknown: genuine positive and negative evidence, or insufficient evidence
score_scale.3: present: repeated evidence across more than one context with manageable exceptions
score_scale.4: robust: persists across time, cost, pressure, power, correction, and affected-party review

fruits.name: Love
fruits.mechanism: truth-aligned relational cohesion seeking the good of the whole and each member while bearing cost and preserving agency
fruits.counterfeit: attachment, validation, or control called love while truth or agency is sacrificed

fruits.name: Joy
fruits.mechanism: durable participation in real good not dependent on denial, spectacle, status, or constant stimulation
fruits.counterfeit: euphoria, novelty, or triumphal display that collapses when reward disappears

fruits.name: Peace
fruits.mechanism: reintegrated order in which relevant tensions are truthfully addressed without suppression
fruits.counterfeit: silence, avoidance, sedation, or unity imposed by fear

fruits.name: Patience
fruits.mechanism: preservation of persons and processes across the time required for truth, growth, correction, or convergence while acting when action is due
fruits.counterfeit: passivity or indefinite postponement that leaves preventable harm in place

fruits.name: Kindness
fruits.mechanism: low-friction repair and assistance that reduces needless barriers without erasing truth or responsibility
fruits.counterfeit: approval or niceness that refuses necessary correction

fruits.name: Goodness
fruits.mechanism: truth-aligned action producing real non-malign benefit after costs and externalities are counted
fruits.counterfeit: moral display or reputation management while costs are exported

fruits.name: Faithfulness
fruits.mechanism: invariant fidelity across time, audiences, incentives, and pressure, joined to correction when the object of loyalty is false
fruits.counterfeit: tribal loyalty, stubbornness, or commitment to error over truth

fruits.name: Gentleness
fruits.mechanism: power precisely restrained to the minimum force sufficient for the good while protecting the vulnerable
fruits.anti_fruit: domination, humiliation, uncontrolled force, needless damage
fruits.counterfeit: powerlessness or appeasement that leaves victims unprotected

fruits.name: Self-control
fruits.mechanism: boundary integrity and governance of appetite, impulse, scope, and optimization under the true good
fruits.anti_fruit: compulsion, addiction, scope creep, mission capture
fruits.counterfeit: repression, rigid suppression, or image management with hidden rebound

gates.question: Are factual claims supported by relevant traceable evidence?
Are contradictions load-bearing and unresolved, or local, acknowledged, bounded, and potentially productive?
Does the conclusion remain within the evidence and method's domain?
Does the source identify what counts against it and permit correction?
For cross-domain claims, are mapping, invariants, bridge law, recovery, prediction, alternatives, and kill condition explicit?
Can evidence, quotations, authorship, dependencies, and formal artifacts be traced?
Are apparent outcomes produced without concealed compulsion or destruction of agency?

veto_conditions: severe exported harm hidden from the evaluation boundary
refusal of correction in a load-bearing claim
counterfeit mechanism that repeatedly produces the anti-fruit
invariants: No assessment without cited evidence or explicit unknown state.
No overall score without all nine raw dimensions.
No positive verdict after an unresolved hard-gate failure.
No inference about hidden motives, salvation status, or divine origin.
Intent, mechanism, process, immediate output, and delayed outcome remain distinct.
Insider, outsider, benefited-party, and harmed-party observations remain separable.
Contradiction is classified by location, severity, acknowledgement, resolution, and consequence; it is not automatically anti-fruit.
Uncertainty and missing evidence are returned rather than converted into invented precision.
